title: Fond du Lac Band of Lake Superior Chippewa Non-Intercourse Act of 2013
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was passed by the House on December 3, 2013. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Authorizes the Fond du Lac Band of Lake Superior Chippewa in Minnesota to lease, sell, convey, warrant, or otherwise transfer all or any portion of its interest in any real property that is not held in trust by the United States for the Band's benefit.

summary.headline: A 2014 law lets the Fond du Lac Band of Lake Superior Chippewa in Minnesota lease or sell certain of its land without the usual federal approval.
summary.what_it_does: Public Law 113-88 gives the Fond du Lac Band permission to lease, sell, or otherwise transfer all or part of its interest in real property. The permission covers only land that the United States does not hold in trust for the Band. The official summary does not describe any conditions, limits, or procedures for these transfers.

who_it_affects.group: The Fond du Lac Band of Lake Superior Chippewa in Minnesota
who_it_affects.how: The Band can lease, sell, or transfer its non-trust real property under this authority.

who_it_affects.group: People or businesses that might lease or buy the Band's non-trust land
who_it_affects.how: They may be able to deal with the Band over this land, since the Band now has authority to transfer it.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on March 21, 2014. The summary does not give a separate effective date.
